what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission moved to amend a Town Meeting Charter article to add itself as an excluded board in paragraph 4.2; the vote result was not audible.
A third-generation farm owner asked the commission to consider extending sewer and water down Chase Road past the farm.
Members discussed bids for a third-party I&I review and the O&M contract, and left the evaluation to a non-posted setting or the 14th.
A commissioner agreed to draft a scope for a pump station audit for review at the next meeting.
The manager said a vendor quoted a meter upload, so she is entering meters by hand; a voucher was presented for approval.

why_it_matters: Sewer extension requests, an outside I&I review and a pump station audit all bear on future sewer rates and capital costs, and a member was unsure the review money is in the budget.
The Charter amendment, if adopted, would change how the commission is treated under the Charter, which may come before voters at Town Meeting.

The I&I third-party review evaluation, set for outside a posted meeting or the 14th.
